title: Freemax Rexa Replacement Vape Pods - 2ml
description: Freemax Rexa Pods are refillable 2ml pods designed for use with selected devices in the Rexa Series, offering reliable flavour and coil performance across a range of vaping styles. Available in five resistances — 0.4ohm, 0.6ohm, 0.8ohm, 1.0ohm, and 1.2ohm — these pods are built to support everything from restricted direct-lung (RDL) to classic mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each Rexa Pod features a mesh coil integrated directly into the pod for easy maintenance and fast flavour delivery. The pods are built from durable materials and incorporate a top-side fill design with a secure rubber plug for clean, convenient refills. Their compact construction and coil options make them ideal for use with 50/50 freebase or nicotine salt e-liquids . While not compatible with every device in the Rexa lineup, these pods are a perfect fit for selected Rexa kits designed around the standard pod format. For full-series compatibility and longer lifespan, consider the Rexa Duomax Pods . Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
